info.title: Mortgage & Loan Amortization Calculator
info.description: Give this API a loan amount, an interest rate, and a repayment term, and it hands back the precise monthly payment plus a complete schedule showing — for every single month — how much goes to interest, how much reduces the balance, and what you still owe. You can also ask 'what if I pay an extra $300 a month?' or 'what if I make a $10,000 lump payment in month 24?' and it will tell you exactly how many months you save and how much interest you avoid. Every number is computed with banker's rounding and a pinned arithmetic rule so that two correct systems running the same inputs produce identical results, down to the cent. No rate lookups, no market data — you supply the rate, the API does the math.
info.x-guidance: POST to /calculate with principal (positive number), annual_rate_percent (0 or above), term_months (1 or above), and start_date (YYYY-MM-DD for the first payment). Optional: extra_monthly_payment (recurring extra principal each month), one_time_payments (list of objects with 'month' and 'amount' keys for lump-sum payments), summary_only (true to skip the row-by-row schedule array), and rounding (decimal places, default 2). The top-level scheduled_payment field is always the base principal-and-interest payment without extras. Use with_extra_payments block when extras are supplied. The schedule array reflects actual cash paid each month including extras. All dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Raises 400 for invalid inputs such as negative principal or zero term.

post.description: Compute the exact monthly payment and full amortization schedule for any fixed-rate loan, with optional extra and lump-sum payments.

422.description: Unprocessable — a required field is missing or the wrong type. Check the detail field for specifics.

402.description: Payment required. Send a signed USDC payment on Base Mainnet or Solana Mainnet using the x402 protocol.

X-Payment-Response.description: x402 payment challenge — base64-encoded JSON with payment details.

400.description: Bad request — your input failed validation or could not be processed. Check the detail field for specifics.

month.title: Month
month.description: Which payment number to apply this lump sum on, starting at 1.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The dollar amount of the one-time lump-sum principal payment. Must be greater than zero.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: The total amount borrowed, in dollars. Must be greater than zero.

annual_rate_percent.title: Annual Rate Percent
annual_rate_percent.description: The yearly interest rate as a plain percentage — enter 6.5 for 6.5%. Enter 0 for an interest-free loan. Must be zero or above.

term_months.title: Term Months
term_months.description: How many monthly payments the loan spans. A 30-year mortgage is 360; a 5-year car loan is 60. Must be at least 1.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: The date of the very first payment, written as YYYY-MM-DD (for example, 2026-07-01).

extra_monthly_payment.title: Extra Monthly Payment
extra_monthly_payment.description: An optional extra amount you put toward principal every single month, on top of the required payment. Defaults to 0.

one_time_payments.title: One Time Payments
one_time_payments.description: An optional list of one-time lump-sum principal payments. Each item needs a 'month' and an 'amount'.

summary_only.title: Summary Only
summary_only.description: Set to true if you only want the totals and scheduled payment — no row-by-row schedule.

rounding.title: Rounding
rounding.description: How many decimal places to round every money value to. Default is 2 (cents). Valid range is 2 to 6.

inputs_echo.description: The key inputs you sent, echoed back for confirmation.

rounding.description: Details about how numbers were rounded.

scheduled_payment.title: Scheduled Payment
scheduled_payment.description: The fixed monthly payment required to pay off the loan on schedule, not counting any extra payments.

summary.description: Overall totals for the loan without any extra payments.

with_extra_payments.description: How the loan changes if you make the extra payments you described. Only appears when extras were supplied.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: The full month-by-month payment table. Omitted when summary_only is true.
